note: Records and questions for the offline retrieval benchmark (server/evals/retrieval/run.ts). Each record is saved through the real save path from one owner message; overlap says by hand whether the question shares a word with the gold record's text or aliases. Questions with no gold measure how often search returns something anyway. set says which experiment a question was written for (base when absent). A ja-split question holds at least one word that the splitter cuts differently from the gold record; it may also differ in vocabulary, which run.ts --misses reports per term. Questions in a set were written before the experiments ran and are not changed after.
